title: Customer Support - Case study BBPress Forum Migration to StackOverflow style Q&A Plugin
description: An update to https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RESTnocKeCI - 'Should we re-open the Community Forums' showing what we've done in the past 2 weeks.   Showcasing our hybrid support solution, Private Tickets for paid users, public Community Q&A and unified search engine.

asr.full_text: Hello lovely TsaiChart people, this is Andrew from the TsaiChart team. About a week and half ago, we asked you the question should we reopen the Forums as a community Q&A and we received a lot of responses from this and the overwhelming unanimous response was yes, you should. However, we didn't want to reopen the forums as it is because we found that this was not really a useful format to give you guys the information you need. The forums were decommissioned in March 2014 after running for approximately two years and when they were decommissioned they had 5,000 posts in 1000 threads. Now what we found was that the forum, unfortunately, incentivises people to have long conversations. We would quite often get this kind of question like this with you know many, many answers. If you click on a question you'll see several user posts and then several staff posts and it just goes on and as a result it's kind of difficult to find the information you need. Really we want things more like this. One question, one answer, or one question and three or four answers maximum so while we are keeping the ticketing system the ticketing system roots all of our sales and support emails through tickets and you will get a response from one of our software engineers probably within the day we have also reopen the forums as a community question and answer page so if you go on to the main menu and click on support and click on community forums it'll take you to this page now what we've actually done is we've gone through all of the forum posts 5,000 forum posts and we have cleaned them we've deleted duplicates, we've deleted obsolete posts that talk about old bugs that have since been, and we have cleaned them. We have deleted duplicates, we have deleted obsolete posts that talk about old bugs that have since been fixed, and we have cleaned up the rest, made sure the content is up to date. Then, we have scripted the migrations over to questions, and you will recognize the format of this immediately if you use a well known questions and answers site. So, here we have a question and we've got several answers and this one is marked as the best answer you can vote on these answers you can vote them up vote them down you can accept unaccept you can edit your own answers you can post in here with a simple markup language so things like bullet lists things like code this will actually format I've seen this working don't don't worry we'll get it working you can add attachments and what we want to do is incentivise you guys to be answering each other's questions and voting on the best answers we're going to be working here too, and we want the best answers to rise to the top, so if you sort by the most votes you'll see the ones which have got the most votes and at the moment there's not many because it's just gone live, but soon we hope it to mount up. Now, something else we've done in order to help you guys and create an excellent support experience is we have built a unified search engine, so if this is not live yep but it will be in a few weeks so if you want to search for something it will give you results which are unified from the forums which will soon be the question and answers and the knowledge base. So it also has an autocomplete here so if you want to search for things it will give you knowledge base answers and it will give you forum answers. Soon to be question answers. We're going to integrate this with the site. What we want you guys to do is start using this and tell us what you think. We'd like you guys to be asking questions, answering questions, commenting and voting and kind of just be active really. I mean you click on your profile here, you're going to see how many questions you have, you're going to see your answers and you're going to see your reputation and the more votes you get the higher your reputation is going to see how many questions you have, you're going to see your answers and you're going to see your reputation. And the more votes you get the higher your reputation is going to go. We want to incentivize people with high reputations. We're thinking of a reward system possibly discounts in the store, possibly listing on our site as a site chart partner. We haven't decided yet but you know by giving you this at least it's going to encourage that your your information will be rewarded with feedback and we also invite your feedback to us. What do you think about what we are doing? Where we are going with the support? Let's take it from there. We hope you enjoy this my friends! This has been an epic job. The team have worked really, really hard to clean 1,000 forum posts and migrate them over. So now we can resume our work on the software and improving and fixing bugs and giving you guys features. Thanks a lot, have a good day, bye.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it explains the migration of an existing forum into a community question-and-answer support system with private tickets and unified search. The described pages show a community forum, support-ticket interface, and technical search results, while requests to ask questions, answer, comment, and vote are presented as ordinary support participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary subject is an operational demonstration and explanation of software support tools, including a community question-and-answer page, ticketing workflow, voting features, and unified search.

evidence.observation: The supplied frame visibly shows a SciChart search page with a search field containing “Performance Tips and Tricks” and listed search results.

The supplied frame visibly shows a SciChart questions page with question listings, voting counts, filters, and an option to add a question.
